# DiligenceOS

> Outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, payroll, tax preparation, and CFO advisory
> for growing businesses and CPA firms across the United States and Australia.

## Core

- [DiligenceOS | Global Bookkeeping & Accounting Services](https://dosacc.com/): DiligenceOS delivers precision bookkeeping, accounting, payroll, tax, and advisory services for ambitious businesses across the US, Australia, and beyond.

## Regions

- [DiligenceOS | Accounting Services for Australian Businesses](https://dosacc.com/au/): Accounting services for Australian businesses: bookkeeping, BAS & GST support, payroll, and advisory - accurate, on time, below in-house cost.
- [DiligenceOS | US Accounting Services for American Businesses](https://dosacc.com/us/): US accounting services: GAAP-compliant bookkeeping, tax preparation, payroll, and advisory for American businesses - up to 75% less than in-house cost.

## Services

- [Hospitality Accounting & Hotel Bookkeeping | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/hospitality-accounting/): Hospitality accounting services: hotel bookkeeping, revenue reconciliation, night audit support, and financial reporting for hotels and hospitality groups.
- [Financial Advisory & Part-Time CFO Services | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/services/advisory/): Part-time CFO and controller services, KPI analysis, cash-flow management, and financial modelling - CFO-level insight without the full-time cost.
- [Outsourced Bookkeeping Services for SMBs | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/services/bookkeeping/): Outsourced bookkeeping services: daily transaction recording, bank reconciliations, AP/AR, and an audit-ready monthly close at up to 75% less than in-house.
- [Financial Forecasting & Budgeting Services | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/services/forecasting/): Financial forecasting and budgeting: rolling forecasts, weekly cash-flow projections, scenario models, and KPI dashboards that guide decisions.
- [Outsourced Payroll Processing Services | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/services/payroll/): End-to-end outsourced payroll processing: payroll runs, statutory withholdings, 941/940 filings, W-2s and 1099s, and benefits administration across locations.

## Industry research

- [Opportunity: The Future of the Accounting Firm | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/opportunity/): A strategic briefing on the accounting profession in Australia and the United States: rising demand, a shrinking pipeline, capacity as the growth lever.
- [Australian Accounting Firms: Capacity | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/opportunity/au/): The growth opportunity facing Australian accounting firms, in a five-part deep dive. The issue is not demand. It is capacity.
- [The Australian Business Opportunity | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/opportunity/au/business-landscape/): Australia
- [Opportunity, Part 1: The Inflection Point | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/opportunity/au/part-1/): Part 1 of a five-part briefing on Australian accounting firms: the executive summary and the inflection point now reshaping the profession.
- [Opportunity, Part 2: The Capacity Crisis | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/opportunity/au/part-2/): Part 2 of a five-part briefing: the Australian accountant capacity crisis and the expanding SME demand base driving it.
- [Opportunity, Part 3: Revenue and Advisory | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/opportunity/au/part-3/): Part 3 of a five-part briefing: the revenue economics of capacity and why advisory is the future of the accounting firm.
- [Opportunity, Part 4: Global Delivery | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/opportunity/au/part-4/): Part 4 of a five-part briefing: the global delivery model, the competitive provider landscape, and the cost of inaction.
- [Opportunity, Part 5: The Strategic Thesis | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/opportunity/au/part-5/): Part 5 of a five-part briefing: the strategic thesis, a graphical benchmark of the delivery market, an in-depth FAQ, and sources.
- [United States: The Capacity Opportunity | DiligenceOS](https://dosacc.com/opportunity/us/): Licensed US accountants have fallen by two-thirds from the 2019 peak, while 36 million small businesses keep generating recurring demand.
